note: HumanLayer announced it is joining Factory on November 4, 2026. The current platform will continue during a transition of at least 30 days, with support for data export, migration to Factory or open-source self-hosting. An exact hosted shutdown date is not stated.
scope: Current HumanLayer hosted platform transition following the announcement that HumanLayer is joining Factory; the notice does not set an exact end date for hosted operation or open-source use.
continuation: HumanLayer offers open-source self-hosting as a continuation path and plans to bring its collaboration features to Factory. The announcement promises refunds for the last several months to paying customers. It does not establish that migration or self-hosting has been completed for any user.

sources.title: HumanLayer is joining Factory
sources.locator: November 4 announcement; transition period and export/migration/self-hosting paragraph
sources.finding: HumanLayer announced it is joining Factory on November 4, 2026. The current platform stays available during a transition of at least 30 days, with data export, Factory migration or open-source self-hosting support and refunds for recent paying customers. No exact hosted shutdown date is stated.

note: Google announced Jules will become read-only after November 11, 2026 and wind down December 31, 2026. The notice offers an export of configuration and session history; code, branches and PRs remain on GitHub.
scope: Google-hosted Jules coding service and sessions
continuation: The notice points to Google Antigravity as a product informed by Jules learnings; it does not promise automatic migration or continued Jules execution. GitHub code and PRs remain with their repositories.

sources.title: Jules Turndown
sources.finding: Google announces read-only after November 11 and wind-down December 31, 2026; configuration and full session history can be exported locally.

note: The announced service end date has passed; customers were told to save code and data before it. New signups were already closed.

sources.title: Ona Cloud is shutting down on October 31, 2026
sources.locator: October 13 announcement; Can I keep using Ona Cloud; How do I save my work; refunds; automatic migration FAQ
sources.finding: Ona announces Cloud wind-down on October 31, 2026; existing Cloud access only until that date and new signup already closed. Customers must back up code/files; October payments and unused purchased credits refunded. Environments do not migrate automatically to Codex. Enterprise or self-hosted offerings are not stated to end.

note: bloop announced its closure and the retirement of vendor-hosted kanban issues, comments, projects and organisations. The announcement explicitly preserves local workspaces.
scope: Commercial subscriptions and vendor-hosted remote services; v0.1.44 project pages are export-only.
continuation: Local workspaces continue, and the project remains open source. Current community maintenance capacity is unverified.

sources.title: Goodbye bloop
sources.locator: Louis Knight-Webb, April 10, 2026; opening and final paragraphs
sources.finding: bloop announced its closure and an open-source, community-maintained continuation. Subscriptions were terminated and recent invoices refunded. Remote services had a 30-day transition window, covering kanban issues, comments, projects and organisations. Local workspaces would continue. No exact service-end date is stated.

sources.title: Release v0.1.44
sources.locator: Release date and What's Changed, especially PR 3387
sources.finding: Latest release listed at retrieval is v0.1.44, published April 24, 2026. It includes export-only project routes, Claude Code 2.1.119 and Codex 0.124.0 updates. Release assets include desktop packages; this is release evidence, not a successful installation.

sources.title: What would a community edition of Vibe Kanban look like?
sources.locator: Louis/stunningpixels opening June 2 and reply June 7
sources.finding: Louis asks for community direction and maintainers. His June 7 reply calls the earlier orchestrator experiment unreleased. This is a discussion, not a committed feature delivery schedule.

sources.title: packages/web-core/src/pages/kanban/ProjectKanban.tsx

sources.finding: LocalProjectKanban and RemoteProjectKanbanShell both call this shared page. It returns ProjectSunsetPage instead of the board, with no alternate branch for a self-hosted API. This links the released project route to the retired UI.
